settings.title: Supreme comfort, performance-ready softness
settings.text:
The new shoe of choice for professional dancers all over the world.

Made using our newly developed, super-moldable B Paste Pro, Flexus molds to the shape of your foot upon wearing, giving it that custom-made feeling right out the box. Could it be your new favorite?

settings.title: Available in two styles
settings.text: Meet Kaia: with a tapered toe, low profile, and an oval platform, and Skye: with higher wings, a wide platform, and a rounded platform. Each style breaks in quickly to suit the needs of professional dancers.

settings.title: Lightweight and effortlessly elegant
settings.text: Lowered sides, a tapered heel, and a gently U-shaped vamp create sleek, flattering lines. Kaia's medium-low crown and Skye's high-medium crown offers dancers tailored options for the shape of their foot.

settings.title: Consistent and confident performance
settings.text: Bloch's Pro Paste in the wings and box provide equal structure and flexibility, whilst Bloch's B Paste in the platform extends the life of the shoe for maintained stability with wear. Skye and Kaia both feature a medium-strength shank.

settings.title: Professional dancers all over the world are switching into Flexus for its supreme comfort, performance-ready softness, and the feeling of freedom it provides on stage.

settings.testimonial:
“The Bloch Flexus pointe shoe has truly been a game-changer in my career. Whether dancing Sugar Plum in Nashville’s Nutcracker or making my debut as Aurora in Sleeping Beauty, I felt completely confident that the Flexus would support me through every demanding step. It molds beautifully to my foot, enhancing my lines while providing the strength, articulation, and freedom I need to perform at my highest level.”

-Colette Tilinski, Company Artist with Nashville Ballet

"They changed my life! I thought European balance was the best shoe I had worn until I tried Flexus. I have never had so much stability on pointe and on flat. They move with my feet and still provide stability. I love them!"

- Madeleine Bell, Professional Dancer, Bloch Professional

“What I enjoy most about my custom Flexus pointe shoes is that they give me the support and precision I need for my rehearsals and performances. I can turn and balance with control. They help me feel grounded yet light, allowing for clean pirouettes and steady poses. Whilst wearing them I’m able to really work through my feet, engaging every muscle and articulating each movement with detail and strength.”

- Yasmine Naghdi, Bloch Ambassador, Principal Dancer
